job.goal: Fix the reported bug with a minimal diff and a regression test.
job.done_definition: Repro test passes, full suite green, reviewer unit signed off.
constraints: Minimal diff: touch only what the bug requires
Every fix lands with a regression test that failed before it
Never weaken an existing test to make the suite pass

units.title: Reproduce the bug as a failing test
Locate the root cause (trace the code path, name file:line)
Fix the root cause; make the repro test pass
Verify: review the fix diff against the constraints, run the full suite

handoff.next_action: Read briefs/CF1.md and write the failing repro test first.
do_not: Do not fix anything while reproducing — CF1 ends with a failing test, nothing else
